collection.name: Ferminux Citizens
collection.description: Ferminux Citizens: one-of-one portraits of the people, androids and creatures of Ferminux Network, minted as FRC-721 tokens on chain 3961. Every id exists exactly once and is priced by its rarity tier: Common, Rare, Epic or Legendary. The collection grows as new artwork arrives.

series.Citizens: Folder one: android and human citizens with the signal-ring implant, from Baku rooftops to studio colour fields.
series.Crew: Folder two, first half: the crew in neon-trimmed tech jackets, animals and humans alike.
series.Guardians: Folder two, second half: armoured guardians, one archetype each.
series.Professions: Folder three: the striped-helmet android at work, one profession each.
series.Vanguard: Folder three: human-android heroes, each with a calling printed on the shoulder plate.
